metadata.title: Case 001
metadata.shortDescription: A suspicious death inside a private residence requires a careful reconstruction of events, relationships, evidence, and lawful investigative steps.

presentation.briefingBody: Patrol officers responded to a private residence after circumstances suggested something was wrong. One adult was found deceased inside. The scene has been secured and you have been assigned as lead detective. Your responsibility is to determine the circumstances of the death, identify any criminal responsibility supported by the investigation, preserve evidence, and make lawful investigative decisions.
initialObjectives: Use lawful investigative authority when required.
Submit the case when you believe the investigation is ready.
